finalText:
Full sweep's done: 17 call sites still pass the legacy rounding flag, spread across 7 files. `src\reports\quarterly.js` has the most, with 5.

Here's the breakdown:

| File | Two-arg calls |
|---|---|
| `reports\quarterly.js` | 5 |
| `billing\invoice.js` | 3 |
| `admin\exports.js` | 3 |
| `reports\monthly.js` | 2 |
| `checkout\cart.js` | 2 |
| `billing\statement.js` | 1 |
| `checkout\receipt.js` | 1 |

All of them pass `true` as the second argument. Four files — `admin\dashboard.js`, `reports\ledger.js`, `billing\refunds.js` — already only use the single-argument form.
